payload.content: For follow-up questions, first identify the entities or values referenced by the most recent relevant prior turn in `history`, then restrict the computation to that candidate set before answering the current question.
If the current question says `those`, `these`, `them`, `it`, `which one`, or similar, do not recompute over the full table unless the wording explicitly asks for a new global result.

rationale: SQA questions often depend on prior turns; generic PoT code was answering follow-ups over the whole table.
